text_block_list.text:
On my day off, Winning Ticket invited me out
to go watch some races together.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Watching the broadcast in your room is nice and all,
but there's nothing quite like the heat of the racetrack, right!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So with that, let's get hyped together
by watching some thrilling races!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
100 meters to go! Sweeping up furiously from the outside!
Number 12 surges past them all and crosses the goooaaal!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOOOOH~~!! What an incredible race!
It's blazing hootttt~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That Umamusume just now was amazing~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, since her trainer is retiring,
she was desperate to send them off with a win no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So that's why she was so full of spirit...!
Congratulations! That was an incredible race!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...A-Mazinggg!! Dedicated to the Trainer—
a victory like that is pure drama, aaahhh~~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, you heard it too, right, Trainer!?
It's so touching! Waaaaahhh!!
choice_data_list: That was an intense race, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Really...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look! The winner is crying!
Now it's making me wanna cry toooo~~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna... I'm gonna put on a race that gets everyone's blood pumpin' like that toooooooo!!

Even while bawling her eyes out,
Winning Ticket renewed her resolve.

However, contrary to that fighting spirit,
her plateau continued—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Compared to Taishin's and Hayahide's times,
I'm not even close... Urrrghhh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "I bet those two are working way harder than I even imagine!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Please extend our training today too!
choice_data_list: Doing any more than this is overkill.
Doing any more than this is overkill.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Because if I don't, I'll be left behind by the two of them!
I won't be able to have a thrilling race!"
Just as she said, Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide's recent growth has been remarkable.

Still, rushing into reckless training
won't lead to good results. That's why—
choice_data_list: Let's channel it into tomorrow's training!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Channel it into tomorrow...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right!? I was getting way too desperate
again, just like during the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Don't panic! Don't let yourself spin out of control!
Stay strong, keep a strong mindset!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
With my desire to show everyone the best race ever,
tomorrow's the day I beat my record!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's it for today!
Great work, Trainer-san!
There was no issue with Winning Ticket's motivation, nor with her training regimen.

"So there's really no need to panic.
It just happens to be a temporary plateau, that's all—"
I just hope things take a turn for the better in the near future...
